passages.note: Bill overview lists Petersen as co-sponsor of SB1457, which bans selective abortions and declares unborn-child rights but sets no gestational limit.

passages.provision_quote: This act does not create or recognize a right to an abortion and does not make lawful an abortion that is currently unlawful.
passages.note: SB1457 bans sex-, race-, and genetic-abnormality-selective abortions and declares unborn-child rights at every stage, but its own construction clause disclaims creating any abortion right or legalizing anything unlawful, so it shows only the restrictive direction, no permitted stage.
Petersen voted Y on SB1457's final Senate reading; because the bill's construction clause creates no abortion right and legalizes nothing, the vote shows direction only, not a specific rung.

rows.reasoning: Petersen co-sponsored and voted Y on SB 1457 (2021), which bans sex-, race-, and genetic-abnormality-selective abortions and declares unborn-child rights 'at every stage of development,' but the act's own construction clause states it 'does not create or recognize a right to an abortion and does not make lawful an abortion that is currently unlawful,' so it establishes no gestational stage permitted or forbidden under the ladder's rungs — only the restrictive direction.
